item.text:
The decision that replaced **“MCP tool subset env var”** was **“Focused default MCP tools”**. Its recorded motivation is:

- **Requirement: “MCP tool-surface scoping”** — users need to expose only a selected subset of CodeGraph MCP tools without editing each client’s MCP configuration.

No separate constraint is recorded for that replacement decision.
